readerCopy.body: The comfort zone can feel especially convincing when nothing is forcing you out of it. The Moon trine the South Node can make old routines, emotional roles, and familiar people feel easy to return to. There may be genuine nourishment in the meal you know, the place you trust, or the person who understands the backstory without an explanation. Enjoy what still restores you. The catch is noticing when comfort quietly becomes a reason to keep living inside a pattern you have already outgrown.
